<details class="intuitionbox" open="">
<summary class="pedago-title">Le but n’est pas d’apprendre un logiciel</summary>
<div class="pedago-body">
<p>C’est de <strong>vérifier</strong> que chaque nombre calculé à la main est bien celui qu’affiche la machine — et de voir qu’une fonction en remplace une page.</p>
<p>Comprendre la formule reste indispensable : c’est ce qui permet de choisir la bonne fonction et de reconnaître une sortie aberrante.</p>
</div>

<section class="level1" id="sur-r">
<h1>Sur R</h1>
<section class="level2" id="charger-et-tirer-léchantillon">
<h2 class="anchored" data-anchor-id="charger-et-tirer-léchantillon">Charger et tirer l’échantillon</h2>
<div class="sourceCode" id="cb1"><pre class="sourceCode r code-with-copy"><code class="sourceCode r"><span id="cb1-1"><a aria-hidden="true" href="#cb1-1" tabindex="-1"></a>sal <span class="ot">&lt;-</span> <span class="fu">read.csv</span>(<span class="st">"salaires.csv"</span>, <span class="at">stringsAsFactors =</span> <span class="cn">TRUE</span>)</span>
<span id="cb1-2"><a aria-hidden="true" href="#cb1-2" tabindex="-1"></a></span>
<span id="cb1-3"><a aria-hidden="true" href="#cb1-3" tabindex="-1"></a><span class="co"># La population</span></span>
<span id="cb1-4"><a aria-hidden="true" href="#cb1-4" tabindex="-1"></a><span class="fu">mean</span>(sal<span class="sc">$</span>salaire)                          <span class="co"># 7158.26</span></span>
<span id="cb1-5"><a aria-hidden="true" href="#cb1-5" tabindex="-1"></a><span class="fu">sd</span>(sal<span class="sc">$</span>salaire) <span class="sc">*</span> <span class="fu">sqrt</span>(<span class="dv">499</span><span class="sc">/</span><span class="dv">500</span>)            <span class="co"># 2598.10  (ecart-type de population)</span></span>
<span id="cb1-6"><a aria-hidden="true" href="#cb1-6" tabindex="-1"></a></span>
<span id="cb1-7"><a aria-hidden="true" href="#cb1-7" tabindex="-1"></a><span class="co"># L'echantillon fil rouge : un identifiant sur dix</span></span>
<span id="cb1-8"><a aria-hidden="true" href="#cb1-8" tabindex="-1"></a>ech <span class="ot">&lt;-</span> <span class="fu">subset</span>(sal, id <span class="sc">%%</span> <span class="dv">10</span> <span class="sc">==</span> <span class="dv">0</span>)</span>
<span id="cb1-9"><a aria-hidden="true" href="#cb1-9" tabindex="-1"></a><span class="fu">nrow</span>(ech)                                  <span class="co"># 50</span></span>
<span id="cb1-10"><a aria-hidden="true" href="#cb1-10" tabindex="-1"></a><span class="fu">mean</span>(ech<span class="sc">$</span>salaire)                          <span class="co"># 7005.80</span></span>
<span id="cb1-11"><a aria-hidden="true" href="#cb1-11" tabindex="-1"></a><span class="fu">sd</span>(ech<span class="sc">$</span>salaire)                            <span class="co"># 2250.98</span></span></code><button class="code-copy-button" title="Copier vers le presse-papier"><i class="bi"></i></button></pre></div>
<details class="intuitionbox" open="">
<summary class="pedago-title">Deux écarts-types, deux touches</summary>
<div class="pedago-body">
<p><code>sd()</code> divise par <span class="math inline">n-1</span> : c’est l’estimateur du chapitre 3.</p>
<p>Pour l’écart-type d’une population complète, il faut multiplier par <span class="math inline">\sqrt{(n-1)/n}</span>. R ne propose pas la seconde formule, parce qu’elle ne sert qu’en statistique descriptive.</p>
</div>
</details>
</section>
<section class="level2" id="intervalle-de-confiance-et-test-de-moyenne">
<h2 class="anchored" data-anchor-id="intervalle-de-confiance-et-test-de-moyenne">Intervalle de confiance et test de moyenne</h2>
<div class="sourceCode" id="cb2"><pre class="sourceCode r code-with-copy"><code class="sourceCode r"><span id="cb2-1"><a aria-hidden="true" href="#cb2-1" tabindex="-1"></a><span class="fu">t.test</span>(ech<span class="sc">$</span>salaire, <span class="at">mu =</span> <span class="dv">6500</span>, <span class="at">alternative =</span> <span class="st">"greater"</span>)</span>
<span id="cb2-2"><a aria-hidden="true" href="#cb2-2" tabindex="-1"></a></span>
<span id="cb2-3"><a aria-hidden="true" href="#cb2-3" tabindex="-1"></a><span class="co">#   t = 1.5889, df = 49, p-value = 0.05933</span></span>
<span id="cb2-4"><a aria-hidden="true" href="#cb2-4" tabindex="-1"></a><span class="co">#   95 percent confidence interval:  6470.05    Inf</span></span>
<span id="cb2-5"><a aria-hidden="true" href="#cb2-5" tabindex="-1"></a><span class="co">#   sample estimates: mean of x  7005.80</span></span>
<span id="cb2-6"><a aria-hidden="true" href="#cb2-6" tabindex="-1"></a></span>
<span id="cb2-7"><a aria-hidden="true" href="#cb2-7" tabindex="-1"></a><span class="fu">t.test</span>(ech<span class="sc">$</span>salaire)<span class="sc">$</span>conf.int               <span class="co"># 6365.94  7645.66</span></span></code><button class="code-copy-button" title="Copier vers le presse-papier"><i class="bi"></i></button></pre></div>
<details class="definitionbox" open="">
<summary class="pedago-title">Une seule fonction fait tout</summary>
<div class="pedago-body">
<p><code>t.test()</code> donne la statistique, les degrés de liberté, la <span class="math inline">p</span>-value, l’intervalle et l’estimation — les cinq étapes du chapitre 12 en une ligne.</p>
<p><code>alternative</code> vaut <code>"two.sided"</code> par défaut, <code>"greater"</code> ou <code>"less"</code> pour un test unilatéral.</p>
</div>
</details>
</section>
<section class="level2" id="proportion-comparaison-anova-khi-deux">
<h2 class="anchored" data-anchor-id="proportion-comparaison-anova-khi-deux">Proportion, comparaison, ANOVA, khi-deux</h2>
<div class="sourceCode" id="cb3"><pre class="sourceCode r code-with-copy"><code class="sourceCode r"><span id="cb3-1"><a aria-hidden="true" href="#cb3-1" tabindex="-1"></a><span class="co"># Proportion : 13 Bac+5 sur 50, contre 15 % annonces</span></span>
<span id="cb3-2"><a aria-hidden="true" href="#cb3-2" tabindex="-1"></a><span class="fu">prop.test</span>(<span class="dv">13</span>, <span class="dv">50</span>, <span class="at">p =</span> <span class="fl">0.15</span>, <span class="at">correct =</span> <span class="cn">FALSE</span>)      <span class="co"># X-squared = 4.745, p = 0.0294</span></span>
<span id="cb3-3"><a aria-hidden="true" href="#cb3-3" tabindex="-1"></a></span>
<span id="cb3-4"><a aria-hidden="true" href="#cb3-4" tabindex="-1"></a><span class="co"># Deux groupes</span></span>
<span id="cb3-5"><a aria-hidden="true" href="#cb3-5" tabindex="-1"></a><span class="fu">t.test</span>(salaire <span class="sc">~</span> sexe, <span class="at">data =</span> sal)                <span class="co"># t = -0.0012, p = 0.9991</span></span>
<span id="cb3-6"><a aria-hidden="true" href="#cb3-6" tabindex="-1"></a></span>
<span id="cb3-7"><a aria-hidden="true" href="#cb3-7" tabindex="-1"></a><span class="co"># Trois groupes</span></span>
<span id="cb3-8"><a aria-hidden="true" href="#cb3-8" tabindex="-1"></a><span class="fu">summary</span>(<span class="fu">aov</span>(salaire <span class="sc">~</span> diplome, <span class="at">data =</span> sal))       <span class="co"># F = 86.28, p &lt; 2e-16</span></span>
<span id="cb3-9"><a aria-hidden="true" href="#cb3-9" tabindex="-1"></a></span>
<span id="cb3-10"><a aria-hidden="true" href="#cb3-10" tabindex="-1"></a><span class="co"># Independance de deux caracteres</span></span>
<span id="cb3-11"><a aria-hidden="true" href="#cb3-11" tabindex="-1"></a><span class="fu">chisq.test</span>(<span class="fu">table</span>(sal<span class="sc">$</span>diplome, sal<span class="sc">$</span>sexe))          <span class="co"># X-squared = 0.2292, df = 2, p = 0.8917</span></span></code><button class="code-copy-button" title="Copier vers le presse-papier"><i class="bi"></i></button></pre></div>
<details class="intuitionbox" open="">
<summary class="pedago-title">Un détail qui change le résultat</summary>
<div class="pedago-body">
<p><code>prop.test()</code> applique par défaut une correction de continuité. Avec <code>correct = FALSE</code>, on retrouve exactement le <span class="math inline">z^2 = 2{,}178^2 = 4{,}745</span> du chapitre 15.</p>
<p>Les deux sont défendables ; ce qui ne l’est pas, c’est de ne pas savoir laquelle on emploie.</p>
</div>
</details>
</section>
<section class="level2" id="la-régression">
<h2 class="anchored" data-anchor-id="la-régression">La régression</h2>
<div class="sourceCode" id="cb4"><pre class="sourceCode r code-with-copy"><code class="sourceCode r"><span id="cb4-1"><a aria-hidden="true" href="#cb4-1" tabindex="-1"></a>mod <span class="ot">&lt;-</span> <span class="fu">lm</span>(salaire <span class="sc">~</span> anciennete, <span class="at">data =</span> sal)</span>
<span id="cb4-2"><a aria-hidden="true" href="#cb4-2" tabindex="-1"></a><span class="fu">summary</span>(mod)</span>
<span id="cb4-3"><a aria-hidden="true" href="#cb4-3" tabindex="-1"></a><span class="fu">confint</span>(mod)</span>
<span id="cb4-4"><a aria-hidden="true" href="#cb4-4" tabindex="-1"></a></span>
<span id="cb4-5"><a aria-hidden="true" href="#cb4-5" tabindex="-1"></a><span class="co"># Coefficients:</span></span>
<span id="cb4-6"><a aria-hidden="true" href="#cb4-6" tabindex="-1"></a><span class="co">#              Estimate  Std. Error  t value  Pr(&gt;|t|)</span></span>
<span id="cb4-7"><a aria-hidden="true" href="#cb4-7" tabindex="-1"></a><span class="co"># (Intercept)  4347.23     177.18     24.54   &lt; 2e-16</span></span>
<span id="cb4-8"><a aria-hidden="true" href="#cb4-8" tabindex="-1"></a><span class="co"># anciennete    277.17      15.06     18.41   &lt; 2e-16</span></span>
<span id="cb4-9"><a aria-hidden="true" href="#cb4-9" tabindex="-1"></a><span class="co">#</span></span>
<span id="cb4-10"><a aria-hidden="true" href="#cb4-10" tabindex="-1"></a><span class="co"># Residual standard error: 2008 on 498 degrees of freedom</span></span>
<span id="cb4-11"><a aria-hidden="true" href="#cb4-11" tabindex="-1"></a><span class="co"># Multiple R-squared: 0.4049,  F-statistic: 338.8 on 1 and 498 DF</span></span></code><button class="code-copy-button" title="Copier vers le presse-papier"><i class="bi"></i></button></pre></div>
<details class="definitionbox" open="">
<summary class="pedago-title">Chaque nombre a été calculé à la main</summary>
<div class="pedago-body">
<p><span class="math inline">277{,}17</span> au chapitre 19, <span class="math inline">15{,}06</span> et <span class="math inline">18{,}41</span> au chapitre 20, <span class="math inline">2\,008</span> et <span class="math inline">0{,}4049</span> également.</p>
<p><strong>Le logiciel n’ajoute rien : il calcule plus vite.</strong></p>
</div>
</details>
</section>
</section>
<section class="level1" id="sur-python">
<h1>Sur Python</h1>
<section class="level2" id="les-mêmes-opérations">
<h2 class="anchored" data-anchor-id="les-mêmes-opérations">Les mêmes opérations</h2>
<div class="sourceCode" id="cb5"><pre class="sourceCode python code-with-copy"><code class="sourceCode python"><span id="cb5-1"><a aria-hidden="true" href="#cb5-1" tabindex="-1"></a><span class="im">import</span> pandas <span class="im">as</span> pd, numpy <span class="im">as</span> np</span>
<span id="cb5-2"><a aria-hidden="true" href="#cb5-2" tabindex="-1"></a><span class="im">from</span> scipy <span class="im">import</span> stats</span>
<span id="cb5-3"><a aria-hidden="true" href="#cb5-3" tabindex="-1"></a></span>
<span id="cb5-4"><a aria-hidden="true" href="#cb5-4" tabindex="-1"></a>sal <span class="op">=</span> pd.read_csv(<span class="st">"salaires.csv"</span>)</span>
<span id="cb5-5"><a aria-hidden="true" href="#cb5-5" tabindex="-1"></a>ech <span class="op">=</span> sal[sal.<span class="bu">id</span> <span class="op">%</span> <span class="dv">10</span> <span class="op">==</span> <span class="dv">0</span>]</span>
<span id="cb5-6"><a aria-hidden="true" href="#cb5-6" tabindex="-1"></a></span>
<span id="cb5-7"><a aria-hidden="true" href="#cb5-7" tabindex="-1"></a>ech.salaire.mean()                    <span class="co"># 7005.80</span></span>
<span id="cb5-8"><a aria-hidden="true" href="#cb5-8" tabindex="-1"></a>ech.salaire.std()                     <span class="co"># 2250.98   (ddof=1 par defaut)</span></span></code><button class="code-copy-button" title="Copier vers le presse-papier"><i class="bi"></i></button></pre></div>
</section>
<section class="level2" id="les-mêmes-opérations-suite">
<h2 class="anchored" data-anchor-id="les-mêmes-opérations-suite">Les mêmes opérations (suite)</h2>
<div class="sourceCode" id="cb6"><pre class="sourceCode python code-with-copy"><code class="sourceCode python"><span id="cb6-1"><a aria-hidden="true" href="#cb6-1" tabindex="-1"></a>stats.ttest_1samp(ech.salaire, <span class="dv">6500</span>, alternative<span class="op">=</span><span class="st">"greater"</span>)</span>
<span id="cb6-2"><a aria-hidden="true" href="#cb6-2" tabindex="-1"></a><span class="co">#   statistic=1.5889, pvalue=0.0593</span></span>
<span id="cb6-3"><a aria-hidden="true" href="#cb6-3" tabindex="-1"></a></span>
<span id="cb6-4"><a aria-hidden="true" href="#cb6-4" tabindex="-1"></a>stats.ttest_ind(sal[sal.sexe<span class="op">==</span><span class="st">"H"</span>].salaire,</span>
<span id="cb6-5"><a aria-hidden="true" href="#cb6-5" tabindex="-1"></a>                sal[sal.sexe<span class="op">==</span><span class="st">"F"</span>].salaire, equal_var<span class="op">=</span><span class="va">False</span>)</span>
<span id="cb6-6"><a aria-hidden="true" href="#cb6-6" tabindex="-1"></a><span class="co">#   statistic=-0.0012, pvalue=0.9991</span></span></code><button class="code-copy-button" title="Copier vers le presse-papier"><i class="bi"></i></button></pre></div>
<details class="intuitionbox" open="">
<summary class="pedago-title">Deux conventions opposées, à connaître</summary>
<div class="pedago-body">
<p><code>pandas.std()</code> divise par <span class="math inline">n-1</span> ; <code>numpy.std()</code> divise par <span class="math inline">n</span>.</p>
<p>Sur cinq cents observations l’écart est invisible ; sur dix il est de <span class="math inline">5\,\%</span>. <strong>C’est la source d’erreur la plus fréquente du passage de R à Python.</strong></p>
</div>
</details>
</section>
<section class="level2" id="anova-khi-deux-et-régression">
<h2 class="anchored" data-anchor-id="anova-khi-deux-et-régression">ANOVA, khi-deux et régression</h2>
<div class="sourceCode" id="cb7"><pre class="sourceCode python code-with-copy"><code class="sourceCode python"><span id="cb7-1"><a aria-hidden="true" href="#cb7-1" tabindex="-1"></a><span class="im">import</span> statsmodels.formula.api <span class="im">as</span> smf</span>
<span id="cb7-2"><a aria-hidden="true" href="#cb7-2" tabindex="-1"></a></span>
<span id="cb7-3"><a aria-hidden="true" href="#cb7-3" tabindex="-1"></a><span class="co"># ANOVA</span></span>
<span id="cb7-4"><a aria-hidden="true" href="#cb7-4" tabindex="-1"></a>groupes <span class="op">=</span> [g.salaire.values <span class="cf">for</span> _, g <span class="kw">in</span> sal.groupby(<span class="st">"diplome"</span>)]</span>
<span id="cb7-5"><a aria-hidden="true" href="#cb7-5" tabindex="-1"></a>stats.f_oneway(<span class="op">*</span>groupes)              <span class="co"># F=86.28, p=3.4e-33</span></span>
<span id="cb7-6"><a aria-hidden="true" href="#cb7-6" tabindex="-1"></a></span>
<span id="cb7-7"><a aria-hidden="true" href="#cb7-7" tabindex="-1"></a><span class="co"># Independance</span></span>
<span id="cb7-8"><a aria-hidden="true" href="#cb7-8" tabindex="-1"></a>stats.chi2_contingency(pd.crosstab(sal.diplome, sal.sexe))</span>
<span id="cb7-9"><a aria-hidden="true" href="#cb7-9" tabindex="-1"></a><span class="co">#   chi2=0.2292, dof=2, p=0.8917</span></span>
<span id="cb7-10"><a aria-hidden="true" href="#cb7-10" tabindex="-1"></a></span>
<span id="cb7-11"><a aria-hidden="true" href="#cb7-11" tabindex="-1"></a><span class="co"># Regression</span></span>
<span id="cb7-12"><a aria-hidden="true" href="#cb7-12" tabindex="-1"></a>mod <span class="op">=</span> smf.ols(<span class="st">"salaire ~ anciennete"</span>, data<span class="op">=</span>sal).fit()</span>
<span id="cb7-13"><a aria-hidden="true" href="#cb7-13" tabindex="-1"></a><span class="bu">print</span>(mod.summary())</span>
<span id="cb7-14"><a aria-hidden="true" href="#cb7-14" tabindex="-1"></a>mod.conf_int()                        <span class="co"># 247.65   306.68</span></span></code><button class="code-copy-button" title="Copier vers le presse-papier"><i class="bi"></i></button></pre></div>
<details class="definitionbox" open="">
<summary class="pedago-title">La correspondance des fonctions</summary>
<div class="pedago-body">
<table class="caption-top table">
<thead>
<tr class="header">

<section class="level1" id="vérifier-les-théorèmes">
<h1>Vérifier les théorèmes</h1>
<section class="level2" id="la-distribution-déchantillonnage-par-simulation">
<h2 class="anchored" data-anchor-id="la-distribution-déchantillonnage-par-simulation">La distribution d’échantillonnage, par simulation</h2>
<div class="sourceCode" id="cb8"><pre class="sourceCode r code-with-copy"><code class="sourceCode r"><span id="cb8-1"><a aria-hidden="true" href="#cb8-1" tabindex="-1"></a><span class="fu">set.seed</span>(<span class="dv">2024</span>)</span>
<span id="cb8-2"><a aria-hidden="true" href="#cb8-2" tabindex="-1"></a>moyennes <span class="ot">&lt;-</span> <span class="fu">replicate</span>(<span class="dv">20000</span>, <span class="fu">mean</span>(<span class="fu">sample</span>(sal<span class="sc">$</span>salaire, <span class="dv">40</span>)))</span>
<span id="cb8-3"><a aria-hidden="true" href="#cb8-3" tabindex="-1"></a></span>
<span id="cb8-4"><a aria-hidden="true" href="#cb8-4" tabindex="-1"></a><span class="fu">mean</span>(moyennes)      <span class="co"># 7159.8   -&gt;  m = 7158.26</span></span>
<span id="cb8-5"><a aria-hidden="true" href="#cb8-5" tabindex="-1"></a><span class="fu">sd</span>(moyennes)        <span class="co"># 392.6    -&gt;  sigma/sqrt(40) = 410.8</span></span>
<span id="cb8-6"><a aria-hidden="true" href="#cb8-6" tabindex="-1"></a>                    <span class="co">#              avec correction finie : 394.4</span></span>
<span id="cb8-7"><a aria-hidden="true" href="#cb8-7" tabindex="-1"></a></span>
<span id="cb8-8"><a aria-hidden="true" href="#cb8-8" tabindex="-1"></a><span class="fu">hist</span>(moyennes, <span class="at">breaks =</span> <span class="dv">50</span>, <span class="at">freq =</span> <span class="cn">FALSE</span>)</span>
<span id="cb8-9"><a aria-hidden="true" href="#cb8-9" tabindex="-1"></a><span class="fu">curve</span>(<span class="fu">dnorm</span>(x, <span class="fl">7158.26</span>, <span class="fl">394.42</span>), <span class="at">add =</span> <span class="cn">TRUE</span>, <span class="at">col =</span> <span class="st">"red"</span>, <span class="at">lwd =</span> <span class="dv">2</span>)</span></code><button class="code-copy-button" title="Copier vers le presse-papier"><i class="bi"></i></button></pre></div>
<details class="intuitionbox" open="">
<summary class="pedago-title">Trois vérifications d’un coup</summary>
<div class="pedago-body">
<p>La moyenne des moyennes tombe sur <span class="math inline">m</span> ; leur écart-type sur <span class="math inline">\sigma/\sqrt{n}</span> corrigé ; et l’histogramme épouse la cloche, alors que les salaires ne sont pas normaux.</p>
<p><strong>Cinq lignes reproduisent tout le chapitre 2.</strong></p>
</div>
</details>
</section>
<section class="level2" id="la-couverture-des-intervalles">
<h2 class="anchored" data-anchor-id="la-couverture-des-intervalles">La couverture des intervalles</h2>
<div class="sourceCode" id="cb9"><pre class="sourceCode r code-with-copy"><code class="sourceCode r"><span id="cb9-1"><a aria-hidden="true" href="#cb9-1" tabindex="-1"></a><span class="fu">set.seed</span>(<span class="dv">7</span>)</span>
<span id="cb9-2"><a aria-hidden="true" href="#cb9-2" tabindex="-1"></a>couvre <span class="ot">&lt;-</span> <span class="fu">replicate</span>(<span class="dv">10000</span>, {</span>
<span id="cb9-3"><a aria-hidden="true" href="#cb9-3" tabindex="-1"></a>  e  <span class="ot">&lt;-</span> <span class="fu">sample</span>(sal<span class="sc">$</span>salaire, <span class="dv">40</span>)</span>
<span id="cb9-4"><a aria-hidden="true" href="#cb9-4" tabindex="-1"></a>  ic <span class="ot">&lt;-</span> <span class="fu">t.test</span>(e)<span class="sc">$</span>conf.int</span>
<span id="cb9-5"><a aria-hidden="true" href="#cb9-5" tabindex="-1"></a>  ic[<span class="dv">1</span>] <span class="sc">&lt;=</span> <span class="fl">7158.26</span> <span class="sc">&amp;</span> <span class="fl">7158.26</span> <span class="sc">&lt;=</span> ic[<span class="dv">2</span>]</span>
<span id="cb9-6"><a aria-hidden="true" href="#cb9-6" tabindex="-1"></a>})</span>
<span id="cb9-7"><a aria-hidden="true" href="#cb9-7" tabindex="-1"></a><span class="fu">mean</span>(couvre)        <span class="co"># 0.9503</span></span></code><button class="code-copy-button" title="Copier vers le presse-papier"><i class="bi"></i></button></pre></div>
<details class="ecobox" open="">
<summary class="pedago-title">La démonstration la plus convaincante du cours</summary>
<div class="pedago-body">
<p>Sur dix mille échantillons, <span class="math inline">95{,}03\,\%</span> des intervalles contiennent la vraie moyenne.</p>
<p>C’est très exactement ce que promettait le chapitre 8 — et c’est une chose de le lire, une autre de le vérifier sur sa propre machine. <strong>Faites tourner ce bloc : il vaut trois heures d’explication.</strong></p>
</div>
</details>
</section>
</section>
<section class="level1" id="ce-quil-faut-retenir">
<h1>Ce qu’il faut retenir</h1>
<section class="level2" id="le-résumé-du-chapitre">
<h2 class="anchored" data-anchor-id="le-résumé-du-chapitre">Le résumé du chapitre</h2>
<details class="definitionbox" open="">
<summary class="pedago-title">Six points</summary>
<div class="pedago-body">
<ol type="1">
<li><code>t.test</code>, <code>prop.test</code>, <code>aov</code>, <code>chisq.test</code>, <code>lm</code> : cinq fonctions couvrent tout le cours sous R.</li>
<li><code>t.test()</code> donne à la fois le test <strong>et</strong> l’intervalle — les deux faces du chapitre 15.</li>
<li><code>prop.test(correct = FALSE)</code> retrouve exactement le <span class="math inline">z</span> calculé à la main.</li>
<li>Attention aux conventions : <code>pandas.std()</code> divise par <span class="math inline">n-1</span>, <code>numpy.std()</code> par <span class="math inline">n</span>.</li>
<li>Toute la sortie de <code>lm</code> a été calculée à la main aux chapitres 19 et 20.</li>
<li>Quelques lignes de simulation <strong>vérifient</strong> la distribution d’échantillonnage et la couverture des intervalles.</li>
</ol>
</div>
</details>
<details class="intuitionbox" open="">
<summary class="pedago-title">La fin du parcours</summary>
<div class="pedago-body">
<p>Nous sommes partis de cinq cents salaires que l’on se contentait de décrire. Nous arrivons à un modèle qui les explique, avec la mesure de sa fiabilité.</p>
<p>Entre les deux, une seule idée aura tout porté : <strong>une statistique calculée sur un échantillon est une variable aléatoire, et l’on connaît sa loi</strong>. Estimer, encadrer, tester, régresser n’en sont que quatre usages.</p>
<p>L’introduction à l’économétrie prend la suite immédiate : mêmes outils, plusieurs variables explicatives, et l’examen systématique des hypothèses du chapitre 19.</p>
</div>
</details>
</section>
</section>
